lead.headline: A quiet night: the lineup holds, Friday's report decides
lead.deck: Kamara is still limited with the back; Love and Jefferson were full Thursday. The lineup as set is the projection lineup.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Alvin Kamara is still limited with his back (Saints report, Paris) and stays the fourth back, and this week's insurance quarterback, Matthew Stafford, went to Aye-Aye at 07:21Z today — Aaron Rodgers is the only free starter left if Jordan Love were to be designated. He should not be: Love was full Thursday and says there is 'no chance' he misses Detroit; Justin Jefferson was full too. Rico Dowdle was limited again with the knee, which can only help Jaylen Warren in Paris. ESPN has AVIATO 60%, 130.8 to JuiceJam's 112.0.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to do this morning
doFirst.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup and no starter is designated.
doFirst.note: Hold Fairbairn (1.0 over Butker) and the Broncos D/ST (0.8 under the Titans, a coin flip on a seat changed 21 Oct).
doFirst.empty: Nothing to fire this Friday morning — the only remaining check is this afternoon's Packers and Vikings designations.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup; no contingency remains.

wire.headline: Nothing to add — two tight ends to weigh on Tuesday
wire.deck: Every receiver riser fills someone else's vacancy and the weakest movable receiver is on the exposure list. Mayer and Hunter Henry are next week's tight-end answers.
